{{Quote|Lieutenant Mak'eef, callsign Babe. Heavy weapons specialist. He used to be a pacifist and a card shark. He started the fighting at Fort Klemark. Thought his fellow soldiers had poisoned his rations.|General [[Elin Garza]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Mak'eef''', callsign '''Babe''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] and member of [[Eclipse Squad]], a [[Republic Special Forces Division]] squad created during the [[Galactic War]]. Prior to his induction into Eclipse Squad, Mak'eef was a card shark and a pacifist;<ref name="TOR" /> he was anxious and self-assured, and signed up as an alternative to fretting over the war,<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Eclipse Squad}}</ref> serving as the unit's heavy weapons specialist. He, like the rest of Eclipse Squad, was implanted with experimental [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] recovered from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]]. However, the implants drove the unit insane, and Mak'eef&mdash;believing that the other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] his food&mdash;started a fight at [[Fort Klemark]] on [[Altair 9]] that resulted in Eclipse Squad massacring the entire Republic garrison. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] tracked the rogue unit to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where she recruited Eclipse Squad's predecessors [[Havoc Squad]] to draw out and [[Death/Legends|kill]] all members of Eclipse Squad.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mak'eef appears as an enemy in "Eclipse Squad," a class mission for the Trooper in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
